To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday’s admin meeting

Renee,

Here’s my rundown for the admin meeting and Dr. Pruitt’s board report.

Game: We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday, which locked up second place in the region. Deshawn Pettaway finished with 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches had even met, so that tells you what his teammates thought of his night. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 touchdowns, including that long touchdown in the third quarter. On that drive, our line had their front pushed about five yards back the whole way. That’s the best I’ve seen them block all year. The defense also held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half.

Playoffs: The AHSAA bracket has us hosting Clanton Valley in the first round Friday, Nov. 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows we have a HOME playoff game. We’d love for our administrators, faculty, students and everybody else to come out and fill the place up. Ticket presale starts Tuesday, and we need gate crew and chain crew confirmed by Wednesday. The boosters also need six more concession workers for the playoff game, with a sign-up sheet going out.

Academics: The nine-week grade check is clean. All 52 players on our roster are eligible, and nobody is on the ineligibility list. Tonya Greer deserves the credit for that, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall has made the difference, and she’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

Boosters: The Boston butt sale finished with 208 butts sold and $6,240 raised against a $4,500 goal. That money is going toward the new sideline headsets. Big thanks to Hargrove’s Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost.

And I haven’t forgotten the bus note. If we win and go on the road, I’ll get the bus information and request to you right away so transportation has it at least five days out.

Thanks,
Coach Tillman
